notes.title: Update 2.003
notes.content:
A small update with mostly some camera additions. 
The first addition is the ability to slightly move the camera away from the player granting a larger visible area to plan a route. Also added a small camera shake when hit by animals. The camera pan at the end of levels now move slower but transition into the next level will be faster. Lastly the main menu has been moved to the side from the bottom.

notes.title: Update 2.001
notes.content:
Last update before release! This update contains reset button for faster resets and some additions to the environment and a new wolf model.

[h3]Changes and Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now manually reset when lying down.
[*] You will now look towards the horizon when finishing a day.
[*] Put all dialogue into speech bubbles.
[*] Updated the skate animation.
[*] Added more variation to comments.
[*] Added fish schools and ice blocks to the ocean.
[*] Sound option replaces the anti aliasing setting.
[*] The lowest quality setting will now disable post processing, fish and ice blocks.
[*] Wolf model changed.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you would never stand up if collapsing from cold when loosing skates.
[*] Fixed a bug where you would keep sliding after reset when collapsing from cold.
[*] Fixed some emissive materials.
[*] Camera will no longer rotate weirdly at reset.
[/list]

notes.title: A Week In The Cold
notes.content:
[h2]The Developer[/h2]
A Week In The Cold is a small indie game made by a single developer, Björn Ståhl. Björn is an electrical engineering student and a hobbyist game developer. Come join the discord server https://discord.gg/uxq4ffd

[h2]The Game[/h2]
You play as Elin, waking up in a strange arctic landscape with no idea of where you are or where you should go. Seemingly stuck in a loop, every time you touch the water or succumb to the biting cold you wake up right where you started.

Move between campfires, try to stay warm and stay away from penguins and that strange ghost wolf that appears out of thin air.

[b]The Main Mechanic[/b]
is the ice on the map, it is extremely slippery and will not allow Elin to either stop nor turn while on it. This will make it very important to properly aim before stepping onto the ice. Hopefully Elin will find a pair of skates which will enable her to steer, although she will still not be able to stop.

[h2]The Demo[/h2]
In the demo you will be able to play the first two days in the cold. Get a taste of the game, it's features and what it has to offer.

notes.title: Update 1.007
notes.content:
This update has a few bug fixes and changes, the focus of the update however has been directed at story and adding dialogue and monologue.

[h3]Changes and Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now skip the text after finishing day 7.
[*] Ice reflections are now prebaked, will improve performance.
[*] Camera should now reset properly at campfires.
[*] Custom cursor added.
[*] A lot of lines has been added and many has had changes,
[*] An extra path has been removed from day 1.
[*] Last campfire on day 1 has been moved.
[*] Skate pickups are now emissive, should be easier to spot in the dark.
[*] Dialogue text is now smaller.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Arms should now release properly when activating campfire.
[*] Marks from skates should no longer appear on snow.
[*] Campfire interact prompts should no longer disappear.
[*] Start position on day 4 is now correct.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.006
notes.content:
Update version 1.006
It contains more bug fixes, minor tweaks and smaller changes to most levels.

[b]Changes to nighttime[/b]
has been made, it is now darker and you have no access to a torch. The ice is more reflective of the night sky, use this to guide you. 


[b]Changes and Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Polished water edges on all levels.
[*] More dialogue on day 1 is now skippable.
[*] Torch removed.
[*] Wolf footstep sound now fades.
[*] Ice is now more reflective during night.
[*] Matches are now slightly emissive, easier to spot in the dark.
[*] Game performance improved.
[*] All confirmation messages now notices when esc/enter is pressed.
[*] Save file location changed to install folder.
[*] Info will now show the difference between night and day.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Elin is now moved by wind when lying down.
[*] Foot sliding mitigated.
[*] Music now fades properly between days.
[*] Wolves now interacts properly with lit campfires.
[*] Correct slide animation is now played on day 5 after loosing skates.
[/list]

notes.title: First Game Update
notes.content:
The first update for A Week In The Cold is here.
It contains bug fixes, minor tweaks, quality of life changes and an overhaul of the movement upon snow.

[b]Movement on snow[/b]
The movement when on snow felt clunky and sometimes irritating when you couldn't choose the direction properly. It has now been remade to allow for finer control of direction while still giving the sensation of walking on ice.


[b]Changes and Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Changes to the dialogue.
[*] Added more lines during the levels.
[*] Tips added when choosing day or night.
[*] You can now skip most dialogues.
[*] The day number is now displayed at the start of the level.
[*] You are now told when and where the game saves.
[*] Added colliders to campfires.
[*] Minor tweaks to the levels.
[*] Added confirmation to pressing exit etc.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] There is now a limit to how slow you can slide on ice, no more getting stuck.
[*] Nighttime should now reduce the amount of animals on the level.
[*] Fixed a bug where the wolf does not disappear after reaching the player.
[*] Wolves will now collide with each other.
[*] Pressing a button during tutorial will now register after said tutorial.
[*] Campfires are no longer hidden by snow.
[*] You are now properly returned to the start menu after finishing the game.
[*] Fixed issue with gaining speed boost when leaving snow.
[*] Player should no longer spawn at campfire lying down.
[/list]
